payment_fees.note: Card and gateway fees we pay on each purchase. The profit guard takes the worst fee of the switched-on payment methods off every credit price before it checks the 60% margin. A method can override these with Fee % and Fixed fee in Admin → Payment methods. Set them to your real contract rates.

video_types.name: Change background
video_types.description: Upload your own video and put it on a new background: a solid colour, your picture, an AI-made scene or a stock video. Your voice and timing stay the same.
video_types.notes: fal VEED video background removal fast (veed/video-background-removal/fast): $0.008 per 30 frames, $0.012 with edge refinement (on). Priced per second at 60 fps worst case = $0.024/s (faster footage is re-timed to 60 fps first). Source: fal.ai/models/VEED/video-background-removal/fast, checked 4 Oct 2026. AI background: one Seedream V4 image ($0.03).

video_types.name: Auto-edit my video
video_types.description: Upload raw footage. We cut silences, filler words and bad takes, put your best line first, add animated captions in your brand colour, music and an end card, and reframe it for Reels and TikTok.
video_types.notes: Priced per second of the RAW upload. Costs: speech-to-text with word timings (ElevenLabs Scribe, priced at $0.40/hour; backup Whisper on fal at a $0.02/min placeholder), one AI edit-plan call per 2 minutes of footage (Claude, $0.062), ffmpeg time ($0.0005/s). Music add-on rules apply (your brand track is free).

video_types.name: Brand music
video_types.description: An original track for your brand: instrumental, or a jingle that sings your brand name. Saved to My brand tracks and free to reuse as the music of any video.
video_types.notes: ElevenLabs Music (direct API, $0.15/min) or ElevenLabs Music on fal (fal-ai/elevenlabs/music, $0.60 per output minute rounded up; off by default). The guard prices on the most expensive enabled AI music row; with no row enabled it assumes $0.60 per started minute. Commercial use: see AI content policy.
